caption: The drawing depicts a headless and armless mannequin dressed in an elegant, floor-length blue gown made of a shiny, reflective fabric. The dress features a strapless bodice with a ruched texture at the neckline and a bow detail at the waist. Draped over the mannequin’s shoulders is a long, sheer shawl with intricate golden lace or embroidery, which hangs down past the waist in front and behind the figure. The background is plain and unadorned, rendered in a neutral off-white color. The overall composition is centralized, with the gown occupying the majority of the visual space and the shadow beneath the dress suggesting a sense of depth.
title: Dress
